resolution: Fixed the overlaps the user caught. Root cause: the z-index tokens order things that share a spot but cannot SEPARATE them. (1) Load-time: the undo/redo/import row and the tier-1 STUDIO info strip were both absolutely pinned at top:8/left:8, so the history icons sat on top of the info text. Folded undo/redo/import INTO the tier-1 left group as one flex bar (threaded canUndo/onUndo/canRedo/onRedo/onImportModel from StudioEditor) and deleted the separate absolute row, so self-overlap is now structurally impossible — verified by self-shot of the exact load state. (2) Paint mode: the paintdiag readout (left:8/bottom:8) covered the compass (left:14/bottom:14); moved to the free bottom-right above the camera dock. Built green. Cannot self-shot paint-mode / dense-selection states headless, so the user needs to confirm the deeper states (esp. whether the left context rail in face mode stays clear of the bottom-left compass/size-readout). SHA 4a15d5a4d.
